resources.string:
New Feature: Campaign Management!
 		- You can now create and save multiple campaigns.
 		- Switch between campaigns whenever you want while keeping each one completely independent.


How to create a new campaign:
 			- Open the Campaigns menu.
 			- Tap the + button.
 			- Choose whether to start a new empty campaign or use your current one as a base.
 			- Your current campaign will be saved automatically.


How to switch campaigns:
 			- Open the Campaigns menu.
 			- Select the campaign you want to play.

Campaign management:
 			- Every campaign stores its own characters and progress.
 			- You can delete campaigns you no longer need at any time.


Organize your adventures, separate different groups, and keep every story ready to continue whenever you return!
 Create your next adventure and keep every campaign organized!
